+
+        if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+            max_diameters[next_member] = -1.0;
+            members[cardinality] = next_member;
+        }
+        current_member = next_member;
+        ++cardinality;
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) *member_count = cardinality;
+}
+
+__global__ void markClustered(const int* __restrict__ members, int member_count,
+                              unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered) {
+    for (int index = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         index < member_count; index += blockDim.x * gridDim.x) {
+        clustered[members[index]] = 1;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void compactActiveSeeds(const int* __restrict__ input, int input_count,
+                                   const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
+                                   int* __restrict__ output,
+                                   int* __restrict__ output_count) {
+    for (int index = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         index < input_count; index += blockDim.x * gridDim.x) {
+        const int seed = input[index];
+        if (!clustered[seed]) {
+            const int position = atomicAdd(output_count, 1);
+            output[position] = seed;
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+int boundedGridSize(size_t work_items, int multiprocessors, int blocks_per_sm = 16) {
+    const size_t needed =
+        (work_items + static_cast<size_t>(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) - 1) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+    return static_cast<int>(std::max<size_t>(1, std::min<size_t>(
+        needed, static_cast<size_t>(multiprocessors) * blocks_per_sm)));
+}
+
+template <bool PrecomputedDistances>
+void launchSeedEvaluation(bool shared_state, int active_count, int batch_rows,
+                          size_t shared_bytes, const Point* points,
+                          const double* distances, const unsigned char* clustered,
+                          const int* active_seeds, int point_count, double threshold,
+                          double* global_state, unsigned long long* best_key) {
+    for (int offset = 0; offset < active_count; offset += batch_rows) {
+        const int rows = std::min(batch_rows, active_count - offset);
+        if (shared_state) {
+            evaluateSeeds<PrecomputedDistances, true>
+                <<<rows, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, shared_bytes>>>(
+                    points, distances, clustered, active_seeds, offset, point_count,
+                    threshold, nullptr, best_key);
+        } else {
+            evaluateSeeds<PrecomputedDistances, false>
+                <<<rows, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+                    points, distances, clustered, active_seeds, offset, point_count,
+                    threshold, global_state, best_key);
+        }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    }
+}
+
+template <bool PrecomputedDistances>
+void launchReplay(bool shared_state, size_t shared_bytes, const Point* points,
+                  const double* distances, const unsigned char* clustered,
+                  int seed, int point_count, double threshold, double* global_state,
+                  int* members, int* member_count) {
+    if (shared_state) {
+        replayWinningSeed<PrecomputedDistances, true>
+            <<<1, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, shared_bytes>>>(
+                points, distances, clustered, seed, point_count, threshold, nullptr,
+                members, member_count);
+    } else {
+        replayWinningSeed<PrecomputedDistances, false>
+            <<<1, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+                points, distances, clustered, seed, point_count, threshold,
+                global_state, members, member_count);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+}
+
+}  // namespace
+

+__global__ void buildDistanceMatrix(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                                    double* __restrict__ distances, int count,
+                                    size_t element_count) {
+    for (size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         index < element_count;
+         index += static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x) {
+        const int first = static_cast<int>(index / count);
+        const int second = static_cast<int>(index - static_cast<size_t>(first) * count);
+        const double dx = points[first].x - points[second].x;
+        const double dy = points[first].y - points[second].y;
+        distances[index] = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
+    }
+}

+template <bool PrecomputedDistances>
+__device__ __forceinline__ double pointDistance(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                                                 const double* __restrict__ distances,
+                                                 int count, int first, int second) {
+    if constexpr (PrecomputedDistances) {
+        return distances[static_cast<size_t>(first) * count + second];
+    } else {
+        const double dx = points[first].x - points[second].x;
+        const double dy = points[first].y - points[second].y;
+        return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
+    }
+}

+// Each block independently reproduces the greedy candidate cluster for one
+// seed. Candidate diameters are updated incrementally, turning the serial
+// O(N*k^2) construction into O(N*k) work for a k-member cluster.
+template <bool PrecomputedDistances, bool SharedState>
+__global__ void evaluateSeeds(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                              const double* __restrict__ distances,
+                              const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
+                              const int* __restrict__ active_seeds,
+                              int seed_offset, int point_count, double threshold,
+                              double* __restrict__ global_state,
+                              unsigned long long* __restrict__ best_key) {
+    extern __shared__ double shared_state[];
+    double* max_diameters = SharedState
+        ? shared_state
+        : global_state + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * point_count;
+    const int seed = active_seeds[seed_offset + blockIdx.x];
+
+    for (int candidate = threadIdx.x; candidate < point_count;
+         candidate += blockDim.x) {
+        max_diameters[candidate] =
+            (clustered[candidate] || candidate == seed) ? -1.0 : 0.0;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int current_member = seed;
+    int cardinality = 1;
+    while (true) {
+        CandidateMinimum local_best{DBL_MAX, -1};
+        for (int candidate = threadIdx.x; candidate < point_count;
+             candidate += blockDim.x) {
+            double max_diameter = max_diameters[candidate];
+            if (max_diameter < 0.0) continue;
+
+            const double candidate_distance =
+                pointDistance<PrecomputedDistances>(points, distances, point_count,
+                                                     current_member, candidate);
+            if (candidate_distance > max_diameter) {
+                max_diameter = candidate_distance;
+            }
+
+            if (max_diameter < threshold) {
+                max_diameters[candidate] = max_diameter;
+                local_best = chooseMinimum(local_best,
+                                           {max_diameter, candidate});
+            } else {
+                // Diameters only grow; this candidate can never become valid.
+                max_diameters[candidate] = -1.0;
+            }
+        }
+
+        const CandidateMinimum block_best = blockMinimum<CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>(local_best);
+        __shared__ int next_member;
+        if (threadIdx.x == 0) next_member = block_best.index;
+        __syncthreads();
+        if (next_member < 0) break;
+
+        if (threadIdx.x == 0) max_diameters[next_member] = -1.0;
+        current_member = next_member;
+        ++cardinality;
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        // Higher cardinality wins; equal cardinality chooses the lowest seed,
+        // exactly matching the original ascending host loop.
+        const unsigned long long key =
+            (static_cast<unsigned long long>(static_cast<unsigned int>(cardinality)) << 32) |
+            (0xffffffffull - static_cast<unsigned int>(seed));
+        atomicMax(best_key, key);
+    }
+}
+
+template <bool PrecomputedDistances, bool SharedState>
+__global__ void replayWinningSeed(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                                  const double* __restrict__ distances,
+                                  const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
+                                  int seed, int point_count, double threshold,
+                                  double* __restrict__ global_state,
+                                  int* __restrict__ members,
+                                  int* __restrict__ member_count) {
+    extern __shared__ double shared_state[];
+    double* max_diameters = SharedState ? shared_state : global_state;
+
+    for (int candidate = threadIdx.x; candidate < point_count;
+         candidate += blockDim.x) {
+        max_diameters[candidate] =
+            (clustered[candidate] || candidate == seed) ? -1.0 : 0.0;
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) members[0] = seed;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int current_member = seed;
+    int cardinality = 1;
+    while (true) {
+        CandidateMinimum local_best{DBL_MAX, -1};
+        for (int candidate = threadIdx.x; candidate < point_count;
+             candidate += blockDim.x) {
+            double max_diameter = max_diameters[candidate];
+            if (max_diameter < 0.0) continue;
+
+            const double candidate_distance =
+                pointDistance<PrecomputedDistances>(points, distances, point_count,
+                                                     current_member, candidate);
+            if (candidate_distance > max_diameter) {
+                max_diameter = candidate_distance;
+            }
+            if (max_diameter < threshold) {
+                max_diameters[candidate] = max_diameter;
+                local_best = chooseMinimum(local_best,
+                                           {max_diameter, candidate});
+            } else {
+                max_diameters[candidate] = -1.0;
+            }
+        }
+
+        const CandidateMinimum block_best = blockMinimum<CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>(local_best);
+        __shared__ int next_member;
+        if (threadIdx.x == 0) next_member = block_best.index;
+        __syncthreads();
+        if (next_member < 0) break;
+
+        if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+            max_diameters[next_member] = -1.0;
+            members[cardinality] = next_member;
+        }
+        current_member = next_member;
+        ++cardinality;
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) *member_count = cardinality;
+}
+
+__global__ void markClustered(const int* __restrict__ members, int member_count,
+                              unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered) {
+    for (int index = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         index < member_count; index += blockDim.x * gridDim.x) {
+        clustered[members[index]] = 1;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void compactActiveSeeds(const int* __restrict__ input, int input_count,
+                                   const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
+                                   int* __restrict__ output,
+                                   int* __restrict__ output_count) {
+    for (int index = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         index < input_count; index += blockDim.x * gridDim.x) {
+        const int seed = input[index];
+        if (!clustered[seed]) {
+            const int position = atomicAdd(output_count, 1);
+            output[position] = seed;
+        }
+    }
+}

+int boundedGridSize(size_t work_items, int multiprocessors, int blocks_per_sm = 16) {
+    const size_t needed =
+        (work_items + static_cast<size_t>(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) - 1) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+    return static_cast<int>(std::max<size_t>(1, std::min<size_t>(
+        needed, static_cast<size_t>(multiprocessors) * blocks_per_sm)));
+}
+
+template <bool PrecomputedDistances>
+void launchSeedEvaluation(bool shared_state, int active_count, int batch_rows,
+                          size_t shared_bytes, const Point* points,
+                          const double* distances, const unsigned char* clustered,
+                          const int* active_seeds, int point_count, double threshold,
+                          double* global_state, unsigned long long* best_key) {
+    for (int offset = 0; offset < active_count; offset += batch_rows) {
+        const int rows = std::min(batch_rows, active_count - offset);
+        if (shared_state) {
+            evaluateSeeds<PrecomputedDistances, true>
+                <<<rows, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, shared_bytes>>>(
+                    points, distances, clustered, active_seeds, offset, point_count,
+                    threshold, nullptr, best_key);
+        } else {
+            evaluateSeeds<PrecomputedDistances, false>
+                <<<rows, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+                    points, distances, clustered, active_seeds, offset, point_count,
+                    threshold, global_state, best_key);
+        }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    }
+}
+
+template <bool PrecomputedDistances>
+void launchReplay(bool shared_state, size_t shared_bytes, const Point* points,
+                  const double* distances, const unsigned char* clustered,
+                  int seed, int point_count, double threshold, double* global_state,
+                  int* members, int* member_count) {
+    if (shared_state) {
+        replayWinningSeed<PrecomputedDistances, true>
+            <<<1, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, shared_bytes>>>(
+                points, distances, clustered, seed, point_count, threshold, nullptr,
+                members, member_count);
+    } else {
+        replayWinningSeed<PrecomputedDistances, false>
+            <<<1, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+                points, distances, clustered, seed, point_count, threshold,
+                global_state, members, member_count);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+}

   104	class DeviceBuffer {
   105	  public:
   106	    DeviceBuffer() = default;
   107	    explicit DeviceBuffer(size_t count) { allocate(count); }
   108	    ~DeviceBuffer() { cudaFree(data_); }
   109	
   110	    DeviceBuffer(const DeviceBuffer&) = delete;
   111	    DeviceBuffer& operator=(const DeviceBuffer&) = delete;
   112	
   113	    DeviceBuffer(DeviceBuffer&& other) noexcept
   114	        : data_(std::exchange(other.data_, nullptr)),
   115	          count_(std::exchange(other.count_, 0)) {}
   116	
   117	    DeviceBuffer& operator=(DeviceBuffer&& other) noexcept {
   118	        if (this != &other) {
   119	            cudaFree(data_);
   120	            data_ = std::exchange(other.data_, nullptr);
   121	            count_ = std::exchange(other.count_, 0);
   122	        }
   123	        return *this;
   124	    }
   125	
   126	    void allocate(size_t count) {
   127	        cudaFree(data_);
   128	        data_ = nullptr;
   129	        count_ = 0;
   130	        if (count != 0) {
   131	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data_), count * sizeof(T)));
   132	            count_ = count;
   133	        }
   134	    }
   135	
   136	    bool tryAllocate(size_t count) {
   137	        cudaFree(data_);
   138	        data_ = nullptr;
   139	        count_ = 0;
   140	        if (count == 0) return true;
   141	        const cudaError_t error =
   142	            cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data_), count * sizeof(T));
   143	        if (error != cudaSuccess) {
   144	            data_ = nullptr;
   145	            cudaGetLastError();
   146	            return false;
   147	        }
   148	        count_ = count;
   149	        return true;
   150	    }
   151	
   152	    T* get() { return data_; }
   153	    const T* get() const { return data_; }
   154	    size_t size() const { return count_; }
   155	
   156	  private:
   157	    T* data_ = nullptr;
   158	    size_t count_ = 0;
   159	};

   161	struct CandidateMinimum {
   162	    double diameter;
   163	    int index;
   164	};
   165	
   166	__device__ __forceinline__ CandidateMinimum chooseMinimum(CandidateMinimum a,
   167	                                                           CandidateMinimum b) {
   168	    if (b.index >= 0 &&
   169	        (a.index < 0 || b.diameter < a.diameter ||
   170	         (b.diameter == a.diameter && b.index < a.index))) {
   171	        return b;
   172	    }
   173	    return a;
   174	}
   175	
   176	__device__ __forceinline__ CandidateMinimum warpMinimum(CandidateMinimum value) {
   177	    constexpr unsigned int full_warp = 0xffffffffu;
   178	    for (int offset = CUDA_WARP_SIZE / 2; offset > 0; offset /= 2) {
   179	        CandidateMinimum other;
   180	        other.diameter = __shfl_down_sync(full_warp, value.diameter, offset);
   181	        other.index = __shfl_down_sync(full_warp, value.index, offset);
   182	        value = chooseMinimum(value, other);
   183	    }
   184	    return value;
   185	}
   186	
   187	template <int BlockSize>
   188	__device__ __forceinline__ CandidateMinimum blockMinimum(CandidateMinimum value) {
   189	    static_assert(BlockSize % CUDA_WARP_SIZE == 0, "whole warps are required");
   190	    constexpr int warp_count = BlockSize / CUDA_WARP_SIZE;
   191	    __shared__ double warp_diameters[warp_count];
   192	    __shared__ int warp_indices[warp_count];
   193	
   194	    const int lane = threadIdx.x & (CUDA_WARP_SIZE - 1);
   195	    const int warp = threadIdx.x / CUDA_WARP_SIZE;
   196	    value = warpMinimum(value);
   197	    if (lane == 0) {
   198	        warp_diameters[warp] = value.diameter;
   199	        warp_indices[warp] = value.index;
   200	    }
   201	    __syncthreads();
   202	
   203	    CandidateMinimum result{DBL_MAX, -1};
   204	    if (warp == 0) {
   205	        if (lane < warp_count) {
   206	            result = {warp_diameters[lane], warp_indices[lane]};
   207	        }
   208	        result = warpMinimum(result);
   209	    }
   210	    return result;
   211	}

   214	    for (int index = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   215	         index < count; index += blockDim.x * gridDim.x) {
   216	        seeds[index] = index;

   220	__global__ void buildDistanceMatrix(const Point* __restrict__ points,
   221	                                    double* __restrict__ distances, int count,
   222	                                    size_t element_count) {
   223	    for (size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   224	         index < element_count;
   225	         index += static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x) {
   226	        const int first = static_cast<int>(index / count);
   227	        const int second = static_cast<int>(index - static_cast<size_t>(first) * count);
   228	        const double dx = points[first].x - points[second].x;
   229	        const double dy = points[first].y - points[second].y;
   230	        distances[index] = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
   231	    }
   232	}
   233	
   234	template <bool PrecomputedDistances>
   235	__device__ __forceinline__ double pointDistance(const Point* __restrict__ points,
   236	                                                 const double* __restrict__ distances,
   237	                                                 int count, int first, int second) {
   238	    if constexpr (PrecomputedDistances) {
   239	        return distances[static_cast<size_t>(first) * count + second];
   240	    } else {
   241	        const double dx = points[first].x - points[second].x;
   242	        const double dy = points[first].y - points[second].y;
   243	        return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
   244	    }
   245	}

   247	// Each block independently reproduces the greedy candidate cluster for one
   248	// seed. Candidate diameters are updated incrementally, turning the serial
   249	// O(N*k^2) construction into O(N*k) work for a k-member cluster.
   250	template <bool PrecomputedDistances, bool SharedState>
   251	__global__ void evaluateSeeds(const Point* __restrict__ points,
   252	                              const double* __restrict__ distances,
   253	                              const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
   254	                              const int* __restrict__ active_seeds,
   255	                              int seed_offset, int point_count, double threshold,
   256	                              double* __restrict__ global_state,
   257	                              unsigned long long* __restrict__ best_key) {
   258	    extern __shared__ double shared_state[];
   259	    double* max_diameters = SharedState
   260	        ? shared_state
   261	        : global_state + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * point_count;
   262	    const int seed = active_seeds[seed_offset + blockIdx.x];
   263	
   264	    for (int candidate = threadIdx.x; candidate < point_count;
   265	         candidate += blockDim.x) {
   266	        max_diameters[candidate] =
   267	            (clustered[candidate] || candidate == seed) ? -1.0 : 0.0;
   268	    }
   269	    __syncthreads();
   270	
   271	    int current_member = seed;
   272	    int cardinality = 1;
   273	    while (true) {
   274	        CandidateMinimum local_best{DBL_MAX, -1};
   275	        for (int candidate = threadIdx.x; candidate < point_count;
   276	             candidate += blockDim.x) {
   277	            double max_diameter = max_diameters[candidate];
   278	            if (max_diameter < 0.0) continue;
   279	
   280	            const double candidate_distance =
   281	                pointDistance<PrecomputedDistances>(points, distances, point_count,
   282	                                                     current_member, candidate);
   283	            if (candidate_distance > max_diameter) {
   284	                max_diameter = candidate_distance;
   285	            }
   286	
   287	            if (max_diameter < threshold) {
   288	                max_diameters[candidate] = max_diameter;
   289	                local_best = chooseMinimum(local_best,
   290	                                           {max_diameter, candidate});
   291	            } else {
   292	                // Diameters only grow; this candidate can never become valid.
   293	                max_diameters[candidate] = -1.0;
   294	            }
   295	        }
   296	
   297	        const CandidateMinimum block_best = blockMinimum<CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>(local_best);
   298	        __shared__ int next_member;
   299	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) next_member = block_best.index;
   300	        __syncthreads();
   301	        if (next_member < 0) break;
   302	
   303	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) max_diameters[next_member] = -1.0;
   304	        current_member = next_member;
   305	        ++cardinality;
   306	        __syncthreads();
   307	    }
   308	
   309	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
   310	        // Higher cardinality wins; equal cardinality chooses the lowest seed,
   311	        // exactly matching the original ascending host loop.
   312	        const unsigned long long key =
   313	            (static_cast<unsigned long long>(static_cast<unsigned int>(cardinality)) << 32) |
   314	            (0xffffffffull - static_cast<unsigned int>(seed));
   315	        atomicMax(best_key, key);
   316	    }
   317	}

   319	template <bool PrecomputedDistances, bool SharedState>
   320	__global__ void replayWinningSeed(const Point* __restrict__ points,
   321	                                  const double* __restrict__ distances,
   322	                                  const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
   323	                                  int seed, int point_count, double threshold,
   324	                                  double* __restrict__ global_state,
   325	                                  int* __restrict__ members,
   326	                                  int* __restrict__ member_count) {
   327	    extern __shared__ double shared_state[];
   328	    double* max_diameters = SharedState ? shared_state : global_state;
   329	
   330	    for (int candidate = threadIdx.x; candidate < point_count;
   331	         candidate += blockDim.x) {
   332	        max_diameters[candidate] =
   333	            (clustered[candidate] || candidate == seed) ? -1.0 : 0.0;
   334	    }
   335	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) members[0] = seed;
   336	    __syncthreads();
   337	
   338	    int current_member = seed;
   339	    int cardinality = 1;
   340	    while (true) {
   341	        CandidateMinimum local_best{DBL_MAX, -1};
   342	        for (int candidate = threadIdx.x; candidate < point_count;
   343	             candidate += blockDim.x) {
   344	            double max_diameter = max_diameters[candidate];
   345	            if (max_diameter < 0.0) continue;
   346	
   347	            const double candidate_distance =
   348	                pointDistance<PrecomputedDistances>(points, distances, point_count,
   349	                                                     current_member, candidate);
   350	            if (candidate_distance > max_diameter) {
   351	                max_diameter = candidate_distance;
   352	            }
   353	            if (max_diameter < threshold) {
   354	                max_diameters[candidate] = max_diameter;
   355	                local_best = chooseMinimum(local_best,
   356	                                           {max_diameter, candidate});
   357	            } else {
   358	                max_diameters[candidate] = -1.0;
   359	            }
   360	        }
   361	
   362	        const CandidateMinimum block_best = blockMinimum<CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>(local_best);
   363	        __shared__ int next_member;
   364	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) next_member = block_best.index;
   365	        __syncthreads();
   366	        if (next_member < 0) break;
   367	
   368	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
   369	            max_diameters[next_member] = -1.0;
   370	            members[cardinality] = next_member;
   371	        }
   372	        current_member = next_member;
   373	        ++cardinality;
   374	        __syncthreads();
   375	    }
   376	
   377	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) *member_count = cardinality;
   378	}

   380	__global__ void markClustered(const int* __restrict__ members, int member_count,
   381	                              unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered) {
   382	    for (int index = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   383	         index < member_count; index += blockDim.x * gridDim.x) {
   384	        clustered[members[index]] = 1;

   388	__global__ void compactActiveSeeds(const int* __restrict__ input, int input_count,
   389	                                   const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
   390	                                   int* __restrict__ output,
   391	                                   int* __restrict__ output_count) {
   392	    for (int index = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   393	         index < input_count; index += blockDim.x * gridDim.x) {
   394	        const int seed = input[index];
   395	        if (!clustered[seed]) {
   396	            const int position = atomicAdd(output_count, 1);
   397	            output[position] = seed;
   398	        }
   399	    }
   400	}

   402	int boundedGridSize(size_t work_items, int multiprocessors, int blocks_per_sm = 16) {
   403	    const size_t needed =
   404	        (work_items + static_cast<size_t>(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) - 1) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
   405	    return static_cast<int>(std::max<size_t>(1, std::min<size_t>(
   406	        needed, static_cast<size_t>(multiprocessors) * blocks_per_sm)));
   407	}
   408	
   409	template <bool PrecomputedDistances>
   410	void launchSeedEvaluation(bool shared_state, int active_count, int batch_rows,
   411	                          size_t shared_bytes, const Point* points,
   412	                          const double* distances, const unsigned char* clustered,
   413	                          const int* active_seeds, int point_count, double threshold,
   414	                          double* global_state, unsigned long long* best_key) {
   415	    for (int offset = 0; offset < active_count; offset += batch_rows) {
   416	        const int rows = std::min(batch_rows, active_count - offset);
   417	        if (shared_state) {
   418	            evaluateSeeds<PrecomputedDistances, true>
   419	                <<<rows, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, shared_bytes>>>(
   420	                    points, distances, clustered, active_seeds, offset, point_count,
   421	                    threshold, nullptr, best_key);
   422	        } else {
   423	            evaluateSeeds<PrecomputedDistances, false>
   424	                <<<rows, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
   425	                    points, distances, clustered, active_seeds, offset, point_count,
   426	                    threshold, global_state, best_key);
   427	        }
   428	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   429	    }
   430	}
   430	}
   431	
   432	template <bool PrecomputedDistances>
   433	void launchReplay(bool shared_state, size_t shared_bytes, const Point* points,
   434	                  const double* distances, const unsigned char* clustered,
   435	                  int seed, int point_count, double threshold, double* global_state,
   436	                  int* members, int* member_count) {
   437	    if (shared_state) {
   438	        replayWinningSeed<PrecomputedDistances, true>
   439	            <<<1, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, shared_bytes>>>(
   440	                points, distances, clustered, seed, point_count, threshold, nullptr,
   441	                members, member_count);
   442	    } else {
   443	        replayWinningSeed<PrecomputedDistances, false>
   444	            <<<1, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
   445	                points, distances, clustered, seed, point_count, threshold,
   446	                global_state, members, member_count);
   447	    }
   448	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   449	}

   453	// Main QT clustering algorithm. All candidate construction, winner selection,
   454	// membership updates, and active-set maintenance execute on the GPU.
   455	std::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,
   456	                                  const double threshold) {
   457	    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());
   458	
   459	    int device = 0;
   460	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDevice(&device));
   461	    cudaDeviceProp properties{};
   462	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&properties, device));
   463	
   464	    DeviceBuffer<Point> device_points(N);
   465	    DeviceBuffer<unsigned char> clustered(N);
   466	    DeviceBuffer<int> active_a(N);
   467	    DeviceBuffer<int> active_b(N);
   468	    DeviceBuffer<int> active_count_device(1);
   469	    DeviceBuffer<int> winning_members(N);
   470	    DeviceBuffer<int> winning_count(1);
   471	    DeviceBuffer<unsigned long long> best_key(1);
   472	
   473	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points.get(), points.data(),
   474	                          static_cast<size_t>(N) * sizeof(Point),
   475	                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   476	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(clustered.get(), 0, static_cast<size_t>(N)));
   477	
   478	    const int utility_grid = boundedGridSize(N, properties.multiProcessorCount);
   479	    initializeActiveSeeds<<<utility_grid, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(active_a.get(), N);
   480	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   481	
   482	    // A precomputed row-major matrix makes every block's distance loads
   483	    // coalesced and avoids recalculating square roots over many outer rounds.
   484	    DeviceBuffer<double> distance_matrix;
   485	    bool have_distance_matrix = false;
   486	    const size_t n_size = static_cast<size_t>(N);
   487	    if (n_size <= std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / n_size &&
   488	        n_size * n_size <= std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(double)) {
   489	        const size_t matrix_elements = n_size * n_size;
   490	        const size_t matrix_bytes = matrix_elements * sizeof(double);
   491	        size_t free_memory = 0;
   492	        size_t total_memory = 0;
   493	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_memory, &total_memory));
   494	        (void)total_memory;
   495	        if (matrix_bytes <= free_memory / 2 &&
   496	            distance_matrix.tryAllocate(matrix_elements)) {
   497	            const int matrix_grid =
   498	                boundedGridSize(matrix_elements, properties.multiProcessorCount, 32);
   499	            buildDistanceMatrix<<<matrix_grid, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
   500	                device_points.get(), distance_matrix.get(), N, matrix_elements);
   501	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   502	            have_distance_matrix = true;
   503	        }
   504	    }
   505	
   506	    const size_t shared_bytes = n_size * sizeof(double);
   507	    const size_t shared_limit =
   508	        static_cast<size_t>(properties.sharedMemPerBlockOptin);
   509	    // Leave room for the statically allocated reduction and control values.
   510	    const bool use_shared_state = shared_bytes + 4096 <= shared_limit;
   511	
   512	    DeviceBuffer<double> global_state;
   513	    int batch_rows = N;
   514	    if (use_shared_state) {
   515	        const int dynamic_bytes = static_cast<int>(shared_bytes);
   516	        if (have_distance_matrix) {
   517	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncSetAttribute(
   518	                evaluateSeeds<true, true>, cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize,
   519	                dynamic_bytes));
   520	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncSetAttribute(
   521	                replayWinningSeed<true, true>,
   522	                cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, dynamic_bytes));
   523	        } else {
   524	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncSetAttribute(
   525	                evaluateSeeds<false, true>, cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize,
   526	                dynamic_bytes));
   527	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncSetAttribute(
   528	                replayWinningSeed<false, true>,
   529	                cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, dynamic_bytes));
   530	        }
   531	    } else {
   532	        size_t free_memory = 0;
   533	        size_t total_memory = 0;
   534	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_memory, &total_memory));
   535	        (void)total_memory;
   536	        const size_t row_bytes = n_size * sizeof(double);
   537	        const size_t affordable_rows = std::max<size_t>(1, (free_memory / 2) / row_bytes);
   538	        batch_rows = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(n_size, affordable_rows));
   539	        while (batch_rows > 0 &&
   540	               !global_state.tryAllocate(static_cast<size_t>(batch_rows) * n_size)) {
   541	            batch_rows /= 2;
   542	        }
   543	        if (batch_rows == 0) {
   544	            cudaFailure(cudaErrorMemoryAllocation, "candidate state allocation",
   545	                        __FILE__, __LINE__);
   546	        }
   547	    }
   548	
   549	    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;
   550	    std::vector<int> host_members(N);
   551	    int active_count = N;
   552	    int* current_active = active_a.get();
   553	    int* next_active = active_b.get();
   554	
   555	    while (active_count > 0) {
   556	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(best_key.get(), 0, sizeof(unsigned long long)));
   557	        if (have_distance_matrix) {
   558	            launchSeedEvaluation<true>(
   559	                use_shared_state, active_count, batch_rows, shared_bytes,
   560	                device_points.get(), distance_matrix.get(), clustered.get(),
   561	                current_active, N, threshold, global_state.get(), best_key.get());
   562	        } else {
   563	            launchSeedEvaluation<false>(
   564	                use_shared_state, active_count, batch_rows, shared_bytes,
   565	                device_points.get(), nullptr, clustered.get(), current_active, N,
   566	                threshold, global_state.get(), best_key.get());
   567	        }
   568	
   569	        unsigned long long host_best_key = 0;
   570	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&host_best_key, best_key.get(), sizeof(host_best_key),
   571	                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   572	        const int expected_cardinality = static_cast<int>(host_best_key >> 32);
   573	        const int best_seed = static_cast<int>(
   574	            0xffffffffu - static_cast<unsigned int>(host_best_key));
   575	        if (expected_cardinality <= 0 || best_seed < 0 || best_seed >= N) break;
   576	
   577	        if (have_distance_matrix) {
   578	            launchReplay<true>(
   579	                use_shared_state, shared_bytes, device_points.get(),
   580	                distance_matrix.get(), clustered.get(), best_seed, N, threshold,
   581	                global_state.get(), winning_members.get(), winning_count.get());
   582	        } else {
   583	            launchReplay<false>(
   584	                use_shared_state, shared_bytes, device_points.get(), nullptr,
   585	                clustered.get(), best_seed, N, threshold, global_state.get(),
   586	                winning_members.get(), winning_count.get());
   587	        }
   588	
   589	        int member_count = 0;
   590	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&member_count, winning_count.get(), sizeof(member_count),
   591	                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   592	        if (member_count != expected_cardinality) {
   593	            std::fprintf(stderr,
   594	                         "CUDA clustering invariant failed: expected %d members, got %d\n",
   595	                         expected_cardinality, member_count);
   596	            std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
   597	        }
   598	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(host_members.data(), winning_members.get(),
   599	                              static_cast<size_t>(member_count) * sizeof(int),
   600	                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   601	
   602	        Cluster cluster;
   603	        cluster.seed_point = best_seed;
   604	        cluster.members.assign(host_members.begin(),
   605	                               host_members.begin() + member_count);
   606	        clusters.push_back(std::move(cluster));
   607	
   608	        const int member_grid =
   609	            boundedGridSize(member_count, properties.multiProcessorCount);
   610	        markClustered<<<member_grid, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
   611	            winning_members.get(), member_count, clustered.get());
   612	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   613	
   614	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(active_count_device.get(), 0, sizeof(int)));
   615	        const int compact_grid =
   616	            boundedGridSize(active_count, properties.multiProcessorCount);
   617	        compactActiveSeeds<<<compact_grid, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
   618	            current_active, active_count, clustered.get(), next_active,
   619	            active_count_device.get());
   620	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   621	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&active_count, active_count_device.get(), sizeof(int),
   622	                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   623	        std::swap(current_active, next_active);
   624	    }
   625	
   626	    return clusters;
   627	}

   629	// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties
   630	bool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,
   631	                     const std::vector<Point>& points,
   632	                     const double threshold) {
   633	    bool valid = true;
   634	    
   635	    printf("Validating clusters:\n");
   636	    
   637	    // Check each cluster
   638	    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {
   639	        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];
   640	        double max_diameter = 0.0;
   641	        
   642	        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)
   643	        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {
   644	            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {
   645	                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]], 
   646	                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);
   647	                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);
   648	            }
   649	        }
   650	        
   651	        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters
   652	            printf("  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\n", 
   653	                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);
   654	        }
   655	        
   656	        // Validate diameter is within threshold
   657	        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error
   658	            printf("ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\n", 
   659	                   c, max_diameter, threshold);
   660	            valid = false;
   661	        }
   662	    }
   663	    
   664	    // Check for duplicate memberships
   665	    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);
   666	    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {
   667	        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {
   668	            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];
   669	            if (membership[member] >= 0) {
   670	                printf("ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\n",
   671	                       member, membership[member], c);
   672	                valid = false;
   673	            }
   674	            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);
   675	        }
   676	    }
   677	    
   678	    // Count clustered points
   679	    int clustered_count = 0;
   680	    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {

+__global__ void buildDistanceMatrix(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                                    double* __restrict__ distances, int count,
+                                    size_t element_count) {
+    for (size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         index < element_count;
+         index += static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x) {
+        const int first = static_cast<int>(index / count);
+        const int second = static_cast<int>(index - static_cast<size_t>(first) * count);
+        const double dx = points[first].x - points[second].x;
+        const double dy = points[first].y - points[second].y;
+        distances[index] = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
+    }

+template <bool PrecomputedDistances>
+__device__ __forceinline__ double pointDistance(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                                                 const double* __restrict__ distances,
+                                                 int count, int first, int second) {
+    if constexpr (PrecomputedDistances) {
+        return distances[static_cast<size_t>(first) * count + second];
+    } else {
+        const double dx = points[first].x - points[second].x;
+        const double dy = points[first].y - points[second].y;
+        return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
+    }
+}

+// Each block independently reproduces the greedy candidate cluster for one
+// seed. Candidate diameters are updated incrementally, turning the serial
+// O(N*k^2) construction into O(N*k) work for a k-member cluster.
+template <bool PrecomputedDistances, bool SharedState>
+__global__ void evaluateSeeds(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                              const double* __restrict__ distances,
+                              const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
+                              const int* __restrict__ active_seeds,
+                              int seed_offset, int point_count, double threshold,
+                              double* __restrict__ global_state,
+                              unsigned long long* __restrict__ best_key) {
+    extern __shared__ double shared_state[];
+    double* max_diameters = SharedState
+        ? shared_state
+        : global_state + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * point_count;
+    const int seed = active_seeds[seed_offset + blockIdx.x];
+
+    for (int candidate = threadIdx.x; candidate < point_count;
+         candidate += blockDim.x) {
+        max_diameters[candidate] =
+            (clustered[candidate] || candidate == seed) ? -1.0 : 0.0;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int current_member = seed;
+    int cardinality = 1;
+    while (true) {
+        CandidateMinimum local_best{DBL_MAX, -1};
+        for (int candidate = threadIdx.x; candidate < point_count;
+             candidate += blockDim.x) {
+            double max_diameter = max_diameters[candidate];
+            if (max_diameter < 0.0) continue;
+
+            const double candidate_distance =
+                pointDistance<PrecomputedDistances>(points, distances, point_count,
+                                                     current_member, candidate);
+            if (candidate_distance > max_diameter) {
+                max_diameter = candidate_distance;
+            }
+
+            if (max_diameter < threshold) {
+                max_diameters[candidate] = max_diameter;
+                local_best = chooseMinimum(local_best,
+                                           {max_diameter, candidate});
+            } else {
+                // Diameters only grow; this candidate can never become valid.
+                max_diameters[candidate] = -1.0;
+            }
+        }
+
+        const CandidateMinimum block_best = blockMinimum<CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>(local_best);
+        __shared__ int next_member;
+        if (threadIdx.x == 0) next_member = block_best.index;
+        __syncthreads();
+        if (next_member < 0) break;
+
+        if (threadIdx.x == 0) max_diameters[next_member] = -1.0;
+        current_member = next_member;
+        ++cardinality;
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        // Higher cardinality wins; equal cardinality chooses the lowest seed,
+        // exactly matching the original ascending host loop.
+        const unsigned long long key =
+            (static_cast<unsigned long long>(static_cast<unsigned int>(cardinality)) << 32) |
+            (0xffffffffull - static_cast<unsigned int>(seed));
+        atomicMax(best_key, key);
+    }
+}
+
+template <bool PrecomputedDistances, bool SharedState>
+__global__ void replayWinningSeed(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                                  const double* __restrict__ distances,
+                                  const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
+                                  int seed, int point_count, double threshold,
+                                  double* __restrict__ global_state,
+                                  int* __restrict__ members,
+                                  int* __restrict__ member_count) {
+    extern __shared__ double shared_state[];
+    double* max_diameters = SharedState ? shared_state : global_state;
+
+    for (int candidate = threadIdx.x; candidate < point_count;
+         candidate += blockDim.x) {
+        max_diameters[candidate] =
+            (clustered[candidate] || candidate == seed) ? -1.0 : 0.0;
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) members[0] = seed;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int current_member = seed;
+    int cardinality = 1;
+    while (true) {
+        CandidateMinimum local_best{DBL_MAX, -1};
+        for (int candidate = threadIdx.x; candidate < point_count;
+             candidate += blockDim.x) {
+            double max_diameter = max_diameters[candidate];
+            if (max_diameter < 0.0) continue;
+
+            const double candidate_distance =
+                pointDistance<PrecomputedDistances>(points, distances, point_count,
+                                                     current_member, candidate);
+            if (candidate_distance > max_diameter) {
+                max_diameter = candidate_distance;
+            }
+            if (max_diameter < threshold) {
+                max_diameters[candidate] = max_diameter;
+                local_best = chooseMinimum(local_best,
+                                           {max_diameter, candidate});
+            } else {
+                max_diameters[candidate] = -1.0;
+            }
+        }
+
+        const CandidateMinimum block_best = blockMinimum<CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>(local_best);
+        __shared__ int next_member;
+        if (threadIdx.x == 0) next_member = block_best.index;
+        __syncthreads();
+        if (next_member < 0) break;
+
+        if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+            max_diameters[next_member] = -1.0;
+            members[cardinality] = next_member;
+        }
+        current_member = next_member;
+        ++cardinality;
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) *member_count = cardinality;
+}
+
+__global__ void markClustered(const int* __restrict__ members, int member_count,
+                              unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered) {
+    for (int index = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         index < member_count; index += blockDim.x * gridDim.x) {
+        clustered[members[index]] = 1;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void compactActiveSeeds(const int* __restrict__ input, int input_count,
+                                   const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
+                                   int* __restrict__ output,
+                                   int* __restrict__ output_count) {
+    for (int index = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         index < input_count; index += blockDim.x * gridDim.x) {
+        const int seed = input[index];
+        if (!clustered[seed]) {
+            const int position = atomicAdd(output_count, 1);
+            output[position] = seed;
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+int boundedGridSize(size_t work_items, int multiprocessors, int blocks_per_sm = 16) {
+    const size_t needed =
+        (work_items + static_cast<size_t>(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) - 1) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+    return static_cast<int>(std::max<size_t>(1, std::min<size_t>(
+        needed, static_cast<size_t>(multiprocessors) * blocks_per_sm)));
+}
+
+template <bool PrecomputedDistances>
+void launchSeedEvaluation(bool shared_state, int active_count, int batch_rows,
+                          size_t shared_bytes, const Point* points,
+                          const double* distances, const unsigned char* clustered,
+                          const int* active_seeds, int point_count, double threshold,
+                          double* global_state, unsigned long long* best_key) {
+    for (int offset = 0; offset < active_count; offset += batch_rows) {
+        const int rows = std::min(batch_rows, active_count - offset);
+        if (shared_state) {
+            evaluateSeeds<PrecomputedDistances, true>
+                <<<rows, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, shared_bytes>>>(
+                    points, distances, clustered, active_seeds, offset, point_count,
+                    threshold, nullptr, best_key);
+        } else {
+            evaluateSeeds<PrecomputedDistances, false>
+                <<<rows, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+                    points, distances, clustered, active_seeds, offset, point_count,
+                    threshold, global_state, best_key);
+        }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    }
+}
+
+template <bool PrecomputedDistances>
+void launchReplay(bool shared_state, size_t shared_bytes, const Point* points,
+                  const double* distances, const unsigned char* clustered,
+                  int seed, int point_count, double threshold, double* global_state,
+                  int* members, int* member_count) {
+    if (shared_state) {
+        replayWinningSeed<PrecomputedDistances, true>
+            <<<1, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, shared_bytes>>>(
+                points, distances, clustered, seed, point_count, threshold, nullptr,
+                members, member_count);
+    } else {
+        replayWinningSeed<PrecomputedDistances, false>
+            <<<1, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+                points, distances, clustered, seed, point_count, threshold,
+                global_state, members, member_count);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+}
+
+}  // namespace

+template <int BlockSize>
+__device__ __forceinline__ CandidateMinimum blockMinimum(CandidateMinimum value) {
+    static_assert(BlockSize % CUDA_WARP_SIZE == 0, "whole warps are required");
+    constexpr int warp_count = BlockSize / CUDA_WARP_SIZE;
+    __shared__ double warp_diameters[warp_count];
+    __shared__ int warp_indices[warp_count];
+    __shared__ int warp_state_indices[warp_count];
+
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & (CUDA_WARP_SIZE - 1);
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x / CUDA_WARP_SIZE;
+    value = warpMinimum(value);
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warp_diameters[warp] = value.diameter;
+        warp_indices[warp] = value.index;
+        warp_state_indices[warp] = value.state_index;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    CandidateMinimum result{DBL_MAX, -1, -1};
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        if (lane < warp_count) {
+            result = {warp_diameters[lane], warp_indices[lane],
+                      warp_state_indices[lane]};
+        }
+        result = warpMinimum(result);
+    }
+    return result;

+__global__ void initializeActiveSeeds(int* seeds, int count) {

+         index < count; index += blockDim.x * gridDim.x) {

+__global__ void buildDistanceMatrix(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                                    double* __restrict__ distances, int count,
+                                    size_t element_count) {
+    for (size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         index < element_count;
+         index += static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x) {
+        const int first = static_cast<int>(index / count);
+        const int second = static_cast<int>(index - static_cast<size_t>(first) * count);
+        const double dx = points[first].x - points[second].x;
+        const double dy = points[first].y - points[second].y;
+        distances[index] = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
+    }
+}

+// Compact each seed's threshold-neighborhood once. Every point that can ever
+// join a seed's cluster must be in this list, so subsequent greedy rounds can
+// avoid scanning the overwhelmingly irrelevant portion of the data set.
+__global__ void buildNeighborLists(const double* __restrict__ distances,
+                                   int point_count, double threshold,
+                                   int* __restrict__ neighbors,
+                                   int* __restrict__ neighbor_counts,
+                                   int* __restrict__ maximum_count) {
+    const int seed = blockIdx.x;
+    __shared__ int count;
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) count = 0;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(seed) * point_count;
+    for (int candidate = threadIdx.x; candidate < point_count;
+         candidate += blockDim.x) {
+        if (candidate != seed && distances[row + candidate] < threshold) {
+            const int position = atomicAdd(&count, 1);
+            neighbors[row + position] = candidate;
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        neighbor_counts[seed] = count;
+        atomicMax(maximum_count, count);
+    }
+}

+        const double dx = points[first].x - points[second].x;
+        const double dy = points[first].y - points[second].y;

+// Each block independently reproduces the greedy candidate cluster for one
+// seed. Candidate diameters are updated incrementally, turning the serial
+// O(N*k^2) construction into O(N*k) work for a k-member cluster.
+template <bool PrecomputedDistances, bool CompactCandidates, bool SharedState>
+__global__ void evaluateSeeds(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                              const double* __restrict__ distances,
+                              const int* __restrict__ neighbors,
+                              const int* __restrict__ neighbor_counts,
+                              const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
+                              const int* __restrict__ active_seeds,
+                              int seed_offset, int point_count, int state_count,
+                              double threshold,
+                              double* __restrict__ global_state,
+                              unsigned long long* __restrict__ best_key) {
+    extern __shared__ double shared_state[];
+    double* max_diameters = SharedState
+        ? shared_state
+        : global_state + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * state_count;
+    const int seed = active_seeds[seed_offset + blockIdx.x];
+    const int candidate_count =

+        : nullptr;

+    for (int position = threadIdx.x; position < candidate_count;
+         position += blockDim.x) {

+        max_diameters[position] =
+            (clustered[candidate] || candidate == seed) ? -1.0 : 0.0;

+        for (int position = threadIdx.x; position < candidate_count;
+             position += blockDim.x) {

+        }

+        ++cardinality;
+        __syncthreads();
+    }

+        // exactly matching the original ascending host loop.

+            (static_cast<unsigned long long>(static_cast<unsigned int>(cardinality)) << 32) |
+            (0xffffffffull - static_cast<unsigned int>(seed));
+        atomicMax(best_key, key);

+__global__ void markClustered(const int* __restrict__ members, int member_count,
+                              unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered) {
+    for (int index = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         index < member_count; index += blockDim.x * gridDim.x) {

+__global__ void compactActiveSeeds(const int* __restrict__ input, int input_count,
+                                   const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
+                                   int* __restrict__ output,
+                                   int* __restrict__ output_count) {
+    for (int index = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         index < input_count; index += blockDim.x * gridDim.x) {
+        const int seed = input[index];
+        if (!clustered[seed]) {
+            const int position = atomicAdd(output_count, 1);
+            output[position] = seed;
+        }
+    }

+int boundedGridSize(size_t work_items, int multiprocessors, int blocks_per_sm = 16) {
+    const size_t needed =
+        (work_items + static_cast<size_t>(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) - 1) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+    return static_cast<int>(std::max<size_t>(1, std::min<size_t>(
+        needed, static_cast<size_t>(multiprocessors) * blocks_per_sm)));
+}

+template <bool PrecomputedDistances>
+void launchSeedEvaluation(bool shared_state, int active_count, int batch_rows,
+                          size_t shared_bytes, const Point* points,
+                          const double* distances, const unsigned char* clustered,
+                          const int* active_seeds, int point_count, double threshold,
+                          double* global_state, unsigned long long* best_key) {
+    for (int offset = 0; offset < active_count; offset += batch_rows) {
+        const int rows = std::min(batch_rows, active_count - offset);
+        if (shared_state) {
+            evaluateSeeds<PrecomputedDistances, true>
+                <<<rows, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, shared_bytes>>>(
+                    points, distances, clustered, active_seeds, offset, point_count,
+                    threshold, nullptr, best_key);
+        } else {
+            evaluateSeeds<PrecomputedDistances, false>
+                <<<rows, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+                    points, distances, clustered, active_seeds, offset, point_count,
+                    threshold, global_state, best_key);
+        }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    }
+}
+
+template <bool PrecomputedDistances>
+void launchReplay(bool shared_state, size_t shared_bytes, const Point* points,
+                  const double* distances, const unsigned char* clustered,
+                  int seed, int point_count, double threshold, double* global_state,
+                  int* members, int* member_count) {
+    if (shared_state) {
+        replayWinningSeed<PrecomputedDistances, true>
+            <<<1, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, shared_bytes>>>(
+                points, distances, clustered, seed, point_count, threshold, nullptr,
+                members, member_count);
+    } else {
+        replayWinningSeed<PrecomputedDistances, false>
+            <<<1, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+                points, distances, clustered, seed, point_count, threshold,
+                global_state, members, member_count);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+}

+template <int BlockSize>
+__device__ __forceinline__ CandidateMinimum blockMinimum(CandidateMinimum value) {
+    static_assert(BlockSize % CUDA_WARP_SIZE == 0, "whole warps are required");
+    constexpr int warp_count = BlockSize / CUDA_WARP_SIZE;
+    __shared__ double warp_diameters[warp_count];
+    __shared__ int warp_indices[warp_count];
+    __shared__ int warp_state_indices[warp_count];
+
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & (CUDA_WARP_SIZE - 1);
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x / CUDA_WARP_SIZE;
+    value = warpMinimum(value);
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warp_diameters[warp] = value.diameter;
+        warp_indices[warp] = value.index;
+        warp_state_indices[warp] = value.state_index;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    CandidateMinimum result{DBL_MAX, -1, -1};
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        if (lane < warp_count) {
+            result = {warp_diameters[lane], warp_indices[lane],
+                      warp_state_indices[lane]};
+        }
+        result = warpMinimum(result);
+    }
+    return result;
+}

+__global__ void buildDistanceMatrix(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                                    double* __restrict__ distances, int count,
+                                    size_t element_count) {
+    for (size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         index < element_count;
+         index += static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x) {
+        const int first = static_cast<int>(index / count);
+        const int second = static_cast<int>(index - static_cast<size_t>(first) * count);
+        const double dx = points[first].x - points[second].x;
+        const double dy = points[first].y - points[second].y;
+        distances[index] = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
+    }
+}

+// Compact each seed's threshold-neighborhood once. Every point that can ever
+// join a seed's cluster must be in this list, so subsequent greedy rounds can
+// avoid scanning the overwhelmingly irrelevant portion of the data set.
+__global__ void buildNeighborLists(const double* __restrict__ distances,
+                                   int point_count, double threshold,
+                                   int* __restrict__ neighbors,
+                                   int* __restrict__ neighbor_counts,
+                                   int* __restrict__ maximum_count) {
+    const int seed = blockIdx.x;
+    __shared__ int count;
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) count = 0;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(seed) * point_count;
+    for (int candidate = threadIdx.x; candidate < point_count;
+         candidate += blockDim.x) {
+        if (candidate != seed && distances[row + candidate] < threshold) {
+            const int position = atomicAdd(&count, 1);
+            neighbors[row + position] = candidate;
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        neighbor_counts[seed] = count;
+        atomicMax(maximum_count, count);
+    }
+}

+    if constexpr (PrecomputedDistances) {
+        return distances[static_cast<size_t>(first) * count + second];
+    } else {
+        const double dx = points[first].x - points[second].x;
+        const double dy = points[first].y - points[second].y;
+        return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

-// Main QT clustering algorithm
+// Each block independently reproduces the greedy candidate cluster for one
+// seed. Candidate diameters are updated incrementally, turning the serial
+// O(N*k^2) construction into O(N*k) work for a k-member cluster.
+template <bool PrecomputedDistances, bool CompactCandidates, bool SharedState>
+__global__ void evaluateSeeds(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                              const double* __restrict__ distances,
+                              const int* __restrict__ neighbors,
+                              const int* __restrict__ neighbor_counts,
+                              const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
+                              const int* __restrict__ active_seeds,
+                              int seed_offset, int point_count, int state_count,
+                              double threshold,
+                              double* __restrict__ global_state,
+                              unsigned long long* __restrict__ best_key) {
+    extern __shared__ double shared_state[];
+    double* max_diameters = SharedState
+        ? shared_state
+        : global_state + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * state_count;
+    const int seed = active_seeds[seed_offset + blockIdx.x];
+    const int candidate_count =
+        CompactCandidates ? neighbor_counts[seed] : point_count;
+    const int* seed_neighbors = CompactCandidates
+        ? neighbors + static_cast<size_t>(seed) * point_count
+        : nullptr;
+
+    for (int position = threadIdx.x; position < candidate_count;
+         position += blockDim.x) {
+        const int candidate = CompactCandidates ? seed_neighbors[position] : position;
+        max_diameters[position] =
+            (clustered[candidate] || candidate == seed) ? -1.0 : 0.0;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int current_member = seed;
+    int cardinality = 1;
+    while (true) {
+        CandidateMinimum local_best{DBL_MAX, -1, -1};
+        for (int position = threadIdx.x; position < candidate_count;
+             position += blockDim.x) {
+            const int candidate = CompactCandidates ? seed_neighbors[position] : position;
+            double max_diameter = max_diameters[position];
+            if (max_diameter < 0.0) continue;
+
+            const double candidate_distance =
+                pointDistance<PrecomputedDistances>(points, distances, point_count,
+                                                     current_member, candidate);
+            if (candidate_distance > max_diameter) {
+                max_diameter = candidate_distance;
+            }
+
+            if (max_diameter < threshold) {
+                max_diameters[position] = max_diameter;
+                local_best = chooseMinimum(local_best,
+                                           {max_diameter, candidate, position});
+            } else {
+                // Diameters only grow; this candidate can never become valid.
+                max_diameters[position] = -1.0;
+            }
+        }
+
+        const CandidateMinimum block_best = blockMinimum<CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>(local_best);
+        __shared__ int next_member;
+        if (threadIdx.x == 0) next_member = block_best.index;
+        __syncthreads();
+        if (next_member < 0) break;
+
+        if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+            max_diameters[block_best.state_index] = -1.0;
+        }
+        current_member = next_member;
+        ++cardinality;
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        // Higher cardinality wins; equal cardinality chooses the lowest seed,
+        // exactly matching the original ascending host loop.
+        const unsigned long long key =
+            (static_cast<unsigned long long>(static_cast<unsigned int>(cardinality)) << 32) |
+            (0xffffffffull - static_cast<unsigned int>(seed));
+        atomicMax(best_key, key);
+    }
+}
+
+template <bool PrecomputedDistances, bool CompactCandidates, bool SharedState>
+__global__ void replayWinningSeed(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                                  const double* __restrict__ distances,
+                                  const int* __restrict__ neighbors,
+                                  const int* __restrict__ neighbor_counts,
+                                  const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
+                                  int seed, int point_count, int state_count,
+                                  double threshold,
+                                  double* __restrict__ global_state,
+                                  int* __restrict__ members,
+                                  int* __restrict__ member_count) {
+    extern __shared__ double shared_state[];
+    double* max_diameters = SharedState ? shared_state : global_state;
+    (void)state_count;
+    const int candidate_count =
+        CompactCandidates ? neighbor_counts[seed] : point_count;
+    const int* seed_neighbors = CompactCandidates
+        ? neighbors + static_cast<size_t>(seed) * point_count
+        : nullptr;
+
+    for (int position = threadIdx.x; position < candidate_count;
+         position += blockDim.x) {
+        const int candidate = CompactCandidates ? seed_neighbors[position] : position;
+        max_diameters[position] =
+            (clustered[candidate] || candidate == seed) ? -1.0 : 0.0;
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) members[0] = seed;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    int current_member = seed;
+    int cardinality = 1;
+    while (true) {
+        CandidateMinimum local_best{DBL_MAX, -1, -1};
+        for (int position = threadIdx.x; position < candidate_count;
+             position += blockDim.x) {
+            const int candidate = CompactCandidates ? seed_neighbors[position] : position;
+            double max_diameter = max_diameters[position];
+            if (max_diameter < 0.0) continue;
+
+            const double candidate_distance =
+                pointDistance<PrecomputedDistances>(points, distances, point_count,
+                                                     current_member, candidate);
+            if (candidate_distance > max_diameter) {
+                max_diameter = candidate_distance;
+            }
+            if (max_diameter < threshold) {
+                max_diameters[position] = max_diameter;
+                local_best = chooseMinimum(local_best,
+                                           {max_diameter, candidate, position});
+            } else {
+                max_diameters[position] = -1.0;
+            }
+        }
+
+        const CandidateMinimum block_best = blockMinimum<CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>(local_best);
+        __shared__ int next_member;
+        if (threadIdx.x == 0) next_member = block_best.index;
+        __syncthreads();
+        if (next_member < 0) break;
+
+        if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+            max_diameters[block_best.state_index] = -1.0;
+            members[cardinality] = next_member;
+        }
+        current_member = next_member;
+        ++cardinality;
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) *member_count = cardinality;
+}

+__global__ void markClustered(const int* __restrict__ members, int member_count,
+                              unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered) {
+    for (int index = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         index < member_count; index += blockDim.x * gridDim.x) {
+        clustered[members[index]] = 1;
+    }
+}

+__global__ void compactActiveSeeds(const int* __restrict__ input, int input_count,
+                                   const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
+                                   int* __restrict__ output,
+                                   int* __restrict__ output_count) {
+    for (int index = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         index < input_count; index += blockDim.x * gridDim.x) {
+        const int seed = input[index];
+        if (!clustered[seed]) {
+            const int position = atomicAdd(output_count, 1);
+            output[position] = seed;
+        }
+    }
+}

+int boundedGridSize(size_t work_items, int multiprocessors, int blocks_per_sm = 16) {
+    const size_t needed =
+        (work_items + static_cast<size_t>(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) - 1) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+    return static_cast<int>(std::max<size_t>(1, std::min<size_t>(
+        needed, static_cast<size_t>(multiprocessors) * blocks_per_sm)));
+}
+
+template <bool PrecomputedDistances>
+void launchSeedEvaluation(bool shared_state, int active_count, int batch_rows,
+                          size_t shared_bytes, const Point* points,
+                          const double* distances, const unsigned char* clustered,
+                          const int* active_seeds, int point_count, double threshold,
+                          double* global_state, unsigned long long* best_key) {
+    for (int offset = 0; offset < active_count; offset += batch_rows) {
+        const int rows = std::min(batch_rows, active_count - offset);
+        if (shared_state) {
+            evaluateSeeds<PrecomputedDistances, true>
+                <<<rows, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, shared_bytes>>>(
+                    points, distances, clustered, active_seeds, offset, point_count,
+                    threshold, nullptr, best_key);
+        } else {
+            evaluateSeeds<PrecomputedDistances, false>
+                <<<rows, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+                    points, distances, clustered, active_seeds, offset, point_count,
+                    threshold, global_state, best_key);
+        }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    }
+}
+
+template <bool PrecomputedDistances>
+void launchReplay(bool shared_state, size_t shared_bytes, const Point* points,
+                  const double* distances, const unsigned char* clustered,
+                  int seed, int point_count, double threshold, double* global_state,
+                  int* members, int* member_count) {
+    if (shared_state) {
+        replayWinningSeed<PrecomputedDistances, true>
+            <<<1, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, shared_bytes>>>(
+                points, distances, clustered, seed, point_count, threshold, nullptr,
+                members, member_count);
+    } else {
+        replayWinningSeed<PrecomputedDistances, false>
+            <<<1, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+                points, distances, clustered, seed, point_count, threshold,
+                global_state, members, member_count);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+}

+struct CandidateMinimum {

+    int index;

+__device__ __forceinline__ CandidateMinimum chooseMinimum(CandidateMinimum a,
+                                                           CandidateMinimum b) {
+    if (b.index >= 0 &&
+        (a.index < 0 || b.diameter < a.diameter ||
+         (b.diameter == a.diameter && b.index < a.index))) {
+        return b;

+__device__ __forceinline__ CandidateMinimum warpMinimum(CandidateMinimum value) {
+    constexpr unsigned int full_warp = 0xffffffffu;
+    for (int offset = CUDA_WARP_SIZE / 2; offset > 0; offset /= 2) {
+        CandidateMinimum other;
+        other.diameter = __shfl_down_sync(full_warp, value.diameter, offset);
+        other.index = __shfl_down_sync(full_warp, value.index, offset);
+        other.state_index = __shfl_down_sync(full_warp, value.state_index, offset);
+        value = chooseMinimum(value, other);
+    }
+    return value;
+}

+template <int BlockSize>
+__device__ __forceinline__ CandidateMinimum blockMinimum(CandidateMinimum value) {

+    constexpr int warp_count = BlockSize / CUDA_WARP_SIZE;
+    __shared__ double warp_diameters[warp_count];

+    value = warpMinimum(value);

+// Each block independently reproduces the greedy candidate cluster for one
+// seed. Candidate diameters are updated incrementally, turning the serial
+// O(N*k^2) construction into O(N*k) work for a k-member cluster.
+template <bool PrecomputedDistances, bool CompactCandidates, bool SharedState>
+__global__ void evaluateSeeds(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                              const double* __restrict__ distances,
+                              const int* __restrict__ neighbors,
+                              const int* __restrict__ neighbor_counts,
+                              const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
+                              const int* __restrict__ active_seeds,
+                              int seed_offset, int point_count, int state_count,
+                              double threshold,
+                              double* __restrict__ global_state,
+                              unsigned long long* __restrict__ best_key) {
